description: This file defines the LoggingExpired command class for the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides functionality to represent and deserialize a command that indicates logging expiry in a connection, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality checks.

classes.name: LoggingExpired
classes.description: A command class representing the expiration of logging in a connectivity connection within the Ditto framework. It includes command data such as connection ID, and methods for construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality.

methods.description: Creates a LoggingExpired instance for a given connection ID with default headers.

methods.name: LoggingExpired.of
methods.description: Creates a LoggingExpired instance for a given connection ID and headers.

methods.description: Creates a LoggingExpired instance from a JSON string.

methods.description: Creates a LoggingExpired instance from a JSON object with headers.

methods.description: Creates a LoggingExpired instance from a JSON object with empty headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command's payload data, specifically the connection ID, to a JSON builder for serialization.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the connection ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is MODIFY.
